claims.sentence: Several economics journals require code and data that reproduce the published results, and their data editors check them before acceptance \citep{aea2026datapolicy,es2026reproducibility}; ACM awards badges to papers whose artifacts are evaluated \citep{acm2020badging}.
claims.claim: ACM awards an 'Artifacts Evaluated' badge to papers whose artifacts undergo evaluation.
claims.excerpt: This badge is applied to papers whose associated artifacts have successfully completed an independent audit.
claims.note: Minor: the badge requires the artifacts to pass the audit ('successfully completed'), not merely be evaluated, and artifact review is optional for ACM venues. Tighter wording: 'ACM awards badges to papers whose artifacts pass an independent evaluation'.
